outcomes: putnami cloud telemetry shows, sets and resets the trace settings and log level Putnami Cloud returns to a workspace's services in their export directive, so a person tunes a running app's telemetry without a redeploy
nonGoals: A parent policy or an expiry on a setting: config-api stores neither yet, and the command gains --parent and --for once it does
Applying a setting to a running service: the workspace collector returns it on the next export, by the telemetry/otlp-push-contract directive

text: putnami cloud telemetry show reads the workspace's telemetry settings through config-api's generated client and prints the workspace row, each service row and the settings each service ends with, field by field; a field no row sets is left out, and the service keeps its own setting.
With --app, it prints the workspace row and that service's row only; --output=json prints the view config-api answers.

putnami cloud telemetry set writes each flag it is given, --budget, --ratio, --floor and --log-level, into the workspace row, or the row of the --app service, and keeps every field of that row it is not given.

It refuses, before any call, a set with no flag and a value out of range: a budget or a floor that is not a whole number from 0 to 1000000, a ratio outside 0 to 1, a log level other than debug, info, warn or error.

requirements.text: putnami cloud telemetry reset removes the workspace row, or the row of the --app service, so its services return to their own settings or to the workspace row.
--app resolves an app the way every cloud command does and names the row by the app's canonical name, the service its telemetry carries; without --app the command reads or writes the workspace row.
